subject: To fold or not to fold...
author: drunknnumpty
body:
So being an IT geek of sorts, well I'm a consultant of sorts around Hardware usages for a Major Bank (no not northern rock before you ask...).. the concept being talked about is grid computing, where you link multiple machines together to harness the processing power and run complex algorithms to work out whatever the program has to do..

Folding seems to be a brand name for this allowing any kind hearted PS3 owners (and PC owners) to let a company use their machine while its not been used for it purpose of playing games.. not really anything new except that you can now use a PS3 as well as a PC...

This has been going on for years, in fact I used to allow SETI to use a number of my home machines to crunch data gleamed from the telescopes to see if there was any sign of intelligent life out in the universe.. sadly my machines did not find anything intelligent out there... or even that much intelligence on this planet...

If you are intrested in learning more there is a website which explains folding and what it is trying to achieve (mainly data crunching for curing diseases)..

http://www.scei.co.jp/folding/en/

Also for those who might rather find an alien so they can blow its head off in real life rather than wait for Halo 3... the seti details are below..

http://setiathome.berkeley.edu/

I know I'm sad to have looked into this but what the hell.. to quote Mr Blofeld - 'I'ts what I do...' 😉

p.s - for those who don't know what SETI I wouldn't worry cause they'll never find you...

theres a thin line between genius and insanity... i think i've fallen off...
